Honeywell International INC Increases Stake in Intercontinental Exchange INC (ICE) 
April 20, 2018 - By Maria Brooks 
Investors sentiment increased to 1.28 in 2017 Q4. Its up 0.23, from 1.05 in 2017Q3. It improved, as 33 investors sold ICE shares while 214 reduced holdings. 80 funds opened positions while 235 raised stakes. 496.95 million shares or 0.82% less from 501.06 million shares in 2017Q3 were reported. Art Ltd Liability Corp invested 0.04% of its portfolio in Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (NYSE:ICE). Dupont Mgmt Corp invested 0.01% in Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (NYSE:ICE). Royal Financial Bank Of Canada has 366,387 shares for 0.01% of their portfolio. Hennessy has invested 0.03% in Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (NYSE:ICE). First Fincl Bank owns 53,387 shares. Zeke Advsrs Lc, a Pennsylvania-based fund reported 9,714 shares. Artisan Prtn Partnership invested 0.26% of its portfolio in Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (NYSE:ICE). Calamos Advsrs Limited Liability Company has invested 0.28% in Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (NYSE:ICE). D Scott Neal has 0.04% invested in Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (NYSE:ICE) for 1,000 shares. Cognios Ltd Limited Liability Company has 0.74% invested in Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (NYSE:ICE) for 27,924 shares. Amalgamated State Bank accumulated 75,397 shares or 0.14% of the stock. Daiwa Securities Group Inc, a Japan-based fund reported 122,862 shares. Webster Retail Bank N A owns 956 shares or 0.01% of their US portfolio. Wall Street Access Asset Management Lc reported 50,631 shares. State Of Tennessee Treasury Department stated it has 271,447 shares or 0.09% of all its holdings. 
Honeywell International Inc increased its stake in Intercontinental Exchange Inc (ICE) by 35.09% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Honeywell International Inc bought 175,300 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.21% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 674,900 shares of the investment bankers and brokers and service company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $47.62 million, up from 499,600 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Honeywell International Inc who had been investing in Intercontinental Exchange Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $43.21 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.34% or $0.25 during the last trading session, reaching $74.37. About 2.47 million shares traded. Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (NYSE:ICE) has risen 20.88% since April 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.33% the S&P500. 
Honeywell International Inc, which manages about $3.02 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 79,800 shares to 392,600 shares, valued at $66.44 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Abbott Lab (NYSE:ABT) by 74,700 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 448,896 shares, and cut its stake in Citigroup Inc (NYSE:C). Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (NYSE:ICE) Ratings Coverage 
Among 11 analysts covering Intercontinental Exchange ( NYSE:ICE ), 10 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 91% are positive. Intercontinental Exchange had 14 analyst reports since November 2, 2017 according to SRatingsIntel. The company was maintained on Thursday, February 8 by Keefe Bruyette & Woods. The stock of Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (NYSE:ICE) earned “Buy” rating by Jefferies on Tuesday, January 16. The company was maintained on Friday, November 3 by Citigroup. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, December 21 by Keefe Bruyette & Woods. Bank of America maintained it with “Buy” rating and $82 target in Thursday, February 8 report. The firm has “Buy” rating by J.P. Morgan given on Tuesday, February 20. The rating was upgraded by JP Morgan on Tuesday, February 20 to “Overweight”. On Friday, November 3 the stock rating was maintained by UBS with “Buy”. The rating was maintained by Keefe Bruyette & Woods with “Buy” on Thursday, November 2. Deutsche Bank maintained it with “Buy” rating and $81 target in Friday, April 6 report.
